description:
Copy the harness demonstration cases that no other test owns into the library test modules of the code they exercise, so the demonstration suite can be deleted without losing coverage.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/harness_demo.rs` (527 lines, 14 tests) is a self-described demonstration of `TestHarness` (`crate::test_harness`, compiled into the library under test support). It re-proves queries, blocking, cycle rejection and gates. Six of its cases have no other owner:

- `:291` item list and resolve, through `list_items` and `show_item` (`crates/jit/src/commands/item.rs`).
- `:314` item-kind compatibility with label coverage, through `resolve_link_label` (`commands/item.rs`).
- `:377` container progress and children, through `issue_progress` and `issue_children` (`crates/jit/src/commands/issue.rs`).
- `:442` the issue status response projection, through `issue_status_response` (`commands/issue.rs`).
- `:462` an empty container rollup, through `StateRollup::from_issues` (`crates/jit/src/output.rs`).
- `:475` archive candidates being complete and non-mutating, through `archive_candidates` (`crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs`).

Shared test support derives shipped item kinds from the default profile package.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each of the six cases has an owning test, with the same assertions, in the test module of the file the Background names for it: `commands/item.rs` for `:291` and `:314`, `commands/issue.rs` for `:377` and `:442`, `output.rs` for `:462` and `commands/archive.rs` for `:475`.
- [hard] REQ-02: A moved case that needs shipped item kinds takes them from the shared derivation.
- [hard] REQ-03: A behaviour an existing test in those modules already owns is not duplicated.
title: Unique harness demonstration cases move beside their owners
